mapper.select: SELECT directive_id, user_id, conversation_id, conversation_generation, source_message_id, source_scope_id, task_id, logical_key, payload_hash, expected_version, expected_goal_revision, kind, content, source_text, artifact_ids_json, status, command_id, applied_version, applied_goal_revision, reason_code, reason_message FROM sq_task_directive WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND directive_id = #{directiveId} AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT directive_id, user_id, conversation_id, conversation_generation, source_message_id, source_scope_id, task_id, logical_key, payload_hash, expected_version, expected_goal_revision, kind, content, source_text, artifact_ids_json, status, command_id, applied_version, applied_goal_revision, reason_code, reason_message FROM sq_task_directive WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source_scope_id = #{scopeId} AND logical_key = #{key} FOR UPDATE

SELECT directive_id, user_id, conversation_id, conversation_generation, source_message_id, source_scope_id, task_id, logical_key, payload_hash, expected_version, expected_goal_revision, kind, content, source_text, artifact_ids_json, status, command_id, applied_version, applied_goal_revision, reason_code, reason_message FROM sq_task_directive WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'APPLIED' AND applied_goal_revision >= #{revision} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY applied_goal_revision FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_task_directive ( directive_id, user_id, conversation_id, conversation_generation, source_message_id, source_scope_id, task_id, logical_key, payload_hash, expected_version, expected_goal_revision, kind, content, source_text, artifact_ids_json, status, next_attempt_at, creator_id, last_updater_id ) VALUES ( #{row.directiveId}, #{row.userId}, #{row.conversationId}, #{row.generation}, #{row.sourceMessageId}, #{row.sourceScopeId}, #{row.taskId}, #{row.logicalKey}, #{row.payloadHash}, #{row.expectedVersion}, #{row.expectedGoalRevision}, #{row.kind}, #{row.content}, #{row.sourceText}, #{row.artifactIdsJson}, 'ACCEPTED', #{now}, #{row.userId}, #{row.userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT directive_id FROM sq_task_directive WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT directive_id, user_id, task_id FROM sq_task_directive WHERE status = 'ACCEPTED' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY next_attempt_at, id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_goal_task SET goal_revision = goal_revision + 1, version = version + 1, answer_revision = answer_revision + 1, input_json = #{input}, completion_proposal_json = NULL, proposal_binding_id = NULL, proposal_turn_id = NULL, proposal_tool_call_id = NULL, proposal_hash = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND version = #{version} AND goal_revision = #{revision} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE sq_goal_task SET completion_proposal_json = NULL, proposal_binding_id = NULL, proposal_turn_id = NULL, proposal_tool_call_id = NULL, proposal_hash = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT operation_id FROM sq_operation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND status IN ('PREPARED', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'IN_FLIGHT', 'UNKNOWN', 'RECONCILING') AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT interaction_id FROM sq_interaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT directive_id, source_message_id, kind, status, applied_version, applied_goal_revision, reason_code, reason_message FROM sq_task_directive WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE

SELECT applied_goal_revision FROM sq_task_directive WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND kind = 'REPLACE' AND status = 'APPLIED' AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY applied_goal_revision DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.command_id FROM sq_command c JOIN sq_runtime_binding b ON b.user_id = c.user_id AND b.binding_id = c.binding_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.task_id = #{taskId} AND b.role = 'MASTER' AND c.action IN ('RESUME', 'RESPOND') AND c.status IN ('PENDING', 'DELIVERING') FOR UPDATE
